name: Exit Engagement Popup
author: Darshan Patani

sections.description:
The Exit Engagement Popup plugin is a tool designed to engage website visitors who are about to leave your site. When a visitor moves their cursor towards the top of the browser window, indicating an intention to exit the site, the plugin triggers a popup. This popup aims to capture the visitor’s attention and encourage them to stay on the site or take a specific action. The plugin allows you to customize the content and appearance to suit your website’s goals and audience. By leveraging exit intent technology, the plugin helps to reduce bounce rates, increase conversions, and maximize the effectiveness of your website’s marketing efforts.

Features

  • Trigger the popup when users attempt to exit your page or navigate away from it.
  • This popup is displayed only once per user to avoid it becoming intrusive.
  • Allows you to show a popup for specific post types or for all pages of your website.
  • Offers customizable popup content, background images, button text, and links.

Usage

  1. Navigate to the ‘Exit Engagement Popup’ settings page.
  2. Customize the popup content & appearance.
  3. Save your changes.
  4. Visit the website and attempt to exit from it to trigger the Exit Engagement Popup.

Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions about the plugin, please submit a support ticket.

License

This plugin is released under the GPLv2 or later license. You are free to use, modify, and distribute this plugin.

Credits

This plugin was developed by Darshan Patani.

External Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

Axios – Promise based HTTP client for the browser and node.js
– Source: GitHub Repository

jQuery Validation – The jQuery Validation Plugin provides drop-in validation for your existing forms, while making all kinds of customizations to fit your application really easy.
– Source: GitHub Repository

Toastr – Toastr is a Javascript library for non-blocking notifications. jQuery is required.
– Source: GitHub Repository
sections.installation:
1. Search for the exit-engagement-popup plugin within the WordPress.org plugin repository and install it directly from there.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under ‘Exit Engagement Popup’ in the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
How can I customize the popup appearance?

You can customize the popup appearance using the settings available in the plugin’s settings page. Options include popup background image, icon, title, description and more.
